method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49345, retrieved 2026-09-07), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49345.txt; compilation table to the Education and Care Services National Law Application Act 2026 Pt 6 Div 7 (in force 1 May 2026); last reprint listed Reprint 4 as at 19 Feb 2016; no compilation number stated. scope: From the seat of the parent of a school-age child (and the child): ss 4, 5, 6 (precompulsory and compulsory education periods, final years); ss 9, 10, 11(2), 11A, 11B-11H (duty to enrol, $2,500; leaving in the final two years for training or employment, with regs 11B-11C); s 29 (work in school hours, $5,000); ss 23, 25, 27, 30 (attendance, excused absence); s 38 ($1,000 parent, $10 child) and the Act's penalty table; ss 26, 39, 40 (Attendance Panels); ss 41, 42 (before prosecution); ss 75-79 with regs 12-16 and Schedule 2 (which government school must enrol the child); ss 97, 98, 99(4)-(5), 105, 106 with regs 61-64 and Schedule 3A (fees, charges, contributions: $60, $235, $25,000).
seat: the parent of a school-age child (and the child)

roles: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
I am the child or student
I employ a child, or would like to

situation_parameters.name: my child is leaving, or has left, school for a course, training or employment
situation_parameters.description: Whether your child is taking up, or has taken up, a course, an apprenticeship, employment or another option instead of school in the final two years of compulsory education (ss 11A-11H)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
questions: May I give the notices for my child's final-years options
Is my child's participation in the options full-time
May my child take this option instead of school in the final two years
What must I do so that my child's option counts instead of school
Is my notice of my child's option in force

situation_parameters.name: my child works, or would work, for someone
situation_parameters.description: Whether your child works, or would work, for someone, paid or unpaid for the purpose of gain (s 29(2))
situation_parameters.role: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
questions: May my child work, or may I let my child work, during school hours

situation_parameters.name: my child has been away from school
situation_parameters.description: Whether your child has missed school on one or more days (the questions on excused absence, the attendance requirement and prosecution for absences arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
questions: Is my child excused from school on that day
Is my child in breach of the attendance requirement on that day
Am I in breach of my duty to ensure my child attends school
May I be prosecuted for my child's absences

situation_parameters.name: my child's case has been, or may be, referred to an Attendance Panel
situation_parameters.description: Whether your child's attendance, or participation in a notified course or employment, has been or may be referred to an Attendance Panel (ss 26, 39, 40)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
questions: May my child's case be referred to an Attendance Panel by this person
May the Attendance Panel do this
May this Attendance Panel deal with my child's case
May someone represent us before the Attendance Panel

situation_parameters.name: my child goes to, or is to enrol at, a government school
situation_parameters.description: Whether your child attends, or is to be enrolled at, a government school (the enrolment rules of ss 75-79 and the fees and charges of ss 97-106 are for government schools only)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child's parent, or the adult responsible for the child
questions: Is my child qualified by residence to enrol at a government school
Is my child entitled to enrol at this local-intake school
Is my child entitled to enrol at this government school with no intake area
Is my child entitled to a kindergarten place at this government school
Must the principal of our local-intake school enrol my child
From outside the intake area, in which priority group is my child
For a kindergarten place, in which priority group is my child
Which year is my child's first charges payment year
Is my child an adult student in this year
Is my child an overseas student under the Act
May the government school charge a fee for instruction for my child
What is the most the government school can charge me this year for materials and services
What is the most the government school can ask me to contribute this year
What is the most the distance-education school can charge for sending materials to my child
Was this year's charge determined in time to have effect
Can my child be kept out of classes because I have not paid the charges
Can unpaid school charges be recovered from me as a debt
What is the most a government school can charge in fees for instruction in a year
As an adult student, is my child exempt from fees for instruction

situation_parameters.name: I am leaving, or have left, school for a course, training or employment
situation_parameters.description: Whether you are taking up, or have taken up, a course, an apprenticeship, employment or another option instead of school in the final two years of compulsory education (s 11B)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child or student
questions: May I take this option instead of school

situation_parameters.name: I have been away from school
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have missed school on one or more days (the questions on excused absence, the attendance requirement and prosecution arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child or student
questions: Am I in breach of the attendance requirement on that day
Is my absence excused on that day
May I be prosecuted for not attending school

situation_parameters.name: I go to, or am to enrol at, a government school
situation_parameters.description: Whether you attend, or are to be enrolled at, a government school (the fees and charges of ss 97-106 are for government schools only)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child or student
questions: Am I an adult student this year
Am I an overseas student
May the government school charge me a fee for instruction
As an adult student, am I exempt from fees for instruction
Can I be kept out of classes because the charges are unpaid
Can unpaid school charges be recovered from me as a student
